text: ACADEMIC CALENDAR INFORMATION The academic calendar contains important academic dates for students.
Students should check the academic calendar for semester commencement dates.
The academic calendar also contains examination periods and important academic activities.
ATTENDANCE INFORMATION Students are required to maintain a minimum attendance of 75 percent.
Students should regularly check their attendance records.
Students whose attendance is below the required percentage may be subject to institutional rules.
EXAMINATION INFORMATION Students must carry their valid college identity card when attending examinations.
Students should report to the examination hall before the scheduled examination time.
Students must follow all examination instructions.
FEES INFORMATION Semester fee payment deadline is 15 October.
Students can pay semester fees through the college online payment portal.
Students should keep the payment receipt after successful payment.
For fee-related queries, students should contact the accounts office.
HOSTEL INFORMATION The college provides hostel facilities for students.
Students staying in the hostel must follow the hostel rules and regulations.
Students should maintain cleanliness in hostel facilities.
Visitors must follow the hostel visitor procedures.
LIBRARY INFORMATION Students can use the college library to access academic books and learning resources.
Students should return borrowed books within the specified period.
Students must follow library rules and maintain silence inside the library.
PLACEMENT INFORMATION Students interested in placement opportunities should register through the placement cell.
Students should regularly check placement announcements.
Students must satisfy the eligibility requirements specified for individual companies.
The college library closes at 7 PM on weekdays.
The computer lab closes at 6 PM on weekdays.
